posts.title: GDT Inspiration for Relatively Thoughtful - Tree Rex!
posts.description: Today it's my turn to share some inspiration for Relatively Thoughtful: I have used a fabulous stamp and die set from Trinity Stamps called Tree Rex! I stamped the main image from the stamp set and coloured it with Promarkers. Then I die cut the image and added it to my card with foam pads. The sentiment is also from the stamp set.
